Believers seek help through patience and prayer; those killed in Allah's way are alive, and the patient who say in disaster they belong to Allah receive blessings and mercy.
Many religious scholars fought alongside prophets without weakening or submitting; they prayed for forgiveness, firm feet and victory, and Allah rewarded them in this world and the Hereafter.
Believers are told to persevere, endure, remain stationed and fear Allah so that they may succeed.
If you punish, match the harm done, but patience is better; the Prophet is told to be patient and not grieve, for Allah is with the God-fearing and good-doers.
Stay patiently with those who call on their Lord morning and evening, do not look past them for worldly adornment, and do not obey the heedless who follow desire.
But for a prior word and set term, punishment would be immediate, so be patient over what they say and glorify your Lord before sunrise and sunset and at night.
The Prophet is told to be patient, for Allah's promise is true, and not to be unsettled by those without certainty.
Believers are told to fear their Lord; those who do good have good in this world, Allah's earth is spacious, and the patient are rewarded without account.
The Prophet is told to be patient, for Allah's promise is true, to ask forgiveness for his sin, and to exalt his Lord with praise evening and morning.
The Prophet is told to be patient, for Allah's promise is true; whether he sees some of it or is taken in death first, they will be returned to Allah.
The Prophet is told to be patient like the messengers of determination; on the Day they see what they are promised, it will seem they stayed only an hour.
The Prophet is told to be patient over what they say and to exalt his Lord with praise before sunrise and sunset, in the night and after prostration.
The Prophet is told to be patient for his Lord's decision, being in His sight, and to exalt Him with praise on rising, at night and after the stars set.
Be patient with what they say and leave the well-off deniers to Allah, who has shackles, fire and choking food for them on the Day the earth and mountains convulse.
Having sent down the Quran progressively, Allah tells the Prophet to be patient, not obey sinners, and remember his Lord's name morning, evening and long into the night.
